name: math_permutation_sign

VINIT.justification: the neutral element before any transpositions occur

TANCH.justification: the kernel of the sign homomorphism containing all even permutations

AFWD.justification: the forward action of swapping two elements to change parity

AREV.justification: the reverse action that restores the previous parity state

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of multiple transpositions

IMSCRIB.justification: the self-recognition of the permutation as either even or odd

FSPLIT.justification: the branching of a permutation into its constituent transpositions

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the original permutation from its transpositions

EVALT.justification: the positive evaluation of a permutation with an even number of swaps

EVALF.justification: the negative evaluation of a permutation with an odd number of swaps

ENGAGR.justification: the simultaneous holding of multiple disjoint cycles before parity resolution

IFIX.justification: the permanent fixation of the sign value in a tensor or matrix

steps.domain_action: initialize the identity permutation on n elements
identify the current state as the base identity
decompose the permutation into a product of transpositions
apply a single transposition to the sequence
compose the new transposition with the existing chain
track the even count of transpositions
apply a reverse transposition to test parity stability
track the odd count of transpositions
reconstitute the full permutation from the transposition chain
hold the disjoint cycle structure in memory
verify the self-consistency of the resulting sign
record the final sign value as +1 or -1
close the operation within the symmetric group boundary

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the sign is a topological invariant of the permutation
